from itertools import product

# Atoms are tuples; a leading "-" on a predicate denotes explicit negation.
def atom(text):
    return tuple(text.split("/"))

def opposite(a):
    p = a[0]
    return ((p[1:] if p.startswith("-") else "-" + p),) + a[1:]

facts = set()

def fact(text):
    facts.add(atom(text))

for text in [
    "named/ant/Tessa",
    "suspects/elk/woodpecker",
    "unites/dugong/flamingo",
    "dreamed_of/flamingo/luxury_aircraft",
    "teacher_assistant/flamingo",
    "has_instrument/gadwall",
    "has_instrument/songbird",
    "named/songbird/Teddy",
    "wants/reindeer/flamingo",
    "-creates_castle/duck/starling",
]:
    fact(text)

# Interpret the numerical, occupational, and name conditions explicitly.
money = {"coyote": 86, "walrus": 57}
if money["coyote"] > money["walrus"]:
    fact("more_money/coyote/walrus")

notebook = (18, 14)
box = (17.8, 23.8)
# Use exact tenths of an inch, allowing the notebook to be rotated.
notebook_tenths = (180, 140)
box_tenths = (178, 238)
if any(
    w <= box_tenths[0] and h <= box_tenths[1]
    for w, h in (notebook_tenths, notebook_tenths[::-1])
):
    fact("notebook_fits/goat")

if 2 + 7 < 13:
    fact("fewer_than_13_friends/otter")
if "Teddy"[0] == "Tessa"[0]:
    fact("same_initial_as_ant/songbird")
# A teacher assistant works in education; dreaming of ownership is not ownership.
fact("works_in_education/flamingo")

rules = []

def rule(number, head, *body):
    rules.append((number, atom(head), tuple(map(atom, body))))

rule(1, "-borrows/coyote/dinosaur", "suspects/X/dachshund")
rule(2, "pays/dinosaur/pelikan", "borrows/coyote/dinosaur")
rule(3, "enjoys/X/fish", "-swims/X/owl")
rule(4, "unites/flamingo/vampire", "brings_oil/goat/flamingo")
rule(5, "captures/badger/cougar", "swears/X/otter")
rule(6, "-hides_cards/flamingo/chihuahua", "works_in_education/flamingo")
rule(7, "-shouts/songbird/dove", "has_instrument/songbird")
rule(8, "creates_castle/songbird/owl", "same_initial_as_ant/songbird")
rule(9, "-swims/otter/seahorse", "in_south_america/otter")
rule(10, "-dances/beetle/pelikan", "surrenders/dalmatian/beetle")
rule(11, "negotiates/goat/bear", "notebook_fits/goat")
rule(12, "persuades/X/mannikin", "-creates_castle/X/starling")
rule(13, "-disarms/X/peafowl", "captures/X/bulldog")
rule(14, "calls/bear/flamingo", "negotiates/goat/bear")
rule(15, "acquires_photo/mermaid/vampire", "captures/X/cougar")
rule(16, "stops_victory/X/mannikin", "creates_castle/X/owl")
rule(17, "suspects/X/pigeon", "-unites/X/vampire", "swears/X/leopard")
rule(18, "stops_victory/peafowl/mannikin", "reveals/X/worm")
rule(19, "shouts/mannikin/lizard", "destroys_wall/X/liger")
rule(20, "wants/otter/dolphin", "destroys_wall/X/poodle")
rule(21, "reveals/X/worm", "suspects/X/woodpecker")
rule(22, "-shouts/X/lizard", "enjoys/X/fish")
rule(23, "neglects/swallow/stork", "suspects/X/pigeon")
rule(24, "-hides_cards/flamingo/chihuahua", "owns/flamingo/luxury_aircraft")
rule(25, "destroys_wall/gadwall/poodle", "has_instrument/gadwall")
rule(26, "swears/X/leopard", "acquires_photo/X/snake")
rule(27, "shouts/X/dove", "builds_power_plant/X/german_shepherd")
rule(28, "borrows/coyote/dinosaur", "more_money/coyote/walrus")
rule(29, "-enjoys/X/beaver", "smiles/X/dinosaur")
rule(30, "smiles/X/dinosaur", "neglects/X/stork")
rule(31, "captures/mannikin/bulldog", "persuades/duck/mannikin")
rule(32, "-captures/X/bulldog", "hugs/X/dragonfly")
rule(33, "captures/dolphin/poodle", "wants/otter/dolphin")
rule(34, "dances/beetle/pelikan", "pays/X/pelikan")
rule(35, "swears/X/dove", "-shouts/X/lizard")
rule(36, "dances/flamingo/crab", "calls/bear/flamingo")
rule(37, "swims/otter/seahorse", "fewer_than_13_friends/otter")
rule(38, "-acquires_photo/flamingo/seal",
     "wants/reindeer/flamingo", "unites/dugong/flamingo")
rule(39, "-swims/mannikin/owl", "stops_victory/peafowl/mannikin")
rule(40, "acquires_photo/X/snake", "-surrenders/X/butterfly")
rule(41, "-unites/X/vampire", "dances/X/crab")
rule(42, "-negotiates/goat/bear", "unites/X/fangtooth")
rule(43, "swears/X/otter", "dances/X/pelikan")
rule(44, "-surrenders/X/butterfly", "-hides_cards/X/chihuahua")
rule(45, "-dances/X/crab", "takes_emperor/X/bee")
rule(46, "-hides_cards/dove/swallow", "swears/mannikin/dove")

preferred = {
    (1, 28), (10, 34), (19, 22), (27, 7), (32, 31),
    (4, 41), (42, 11), (45, 36), (9, 37),
}

# Exhaustively ground every variable over the finite set of named constants.
constants = {v for a in facts for v in a[1:]}
for _, head, body in rules:
    constants.update(
        v for a in (head,) + body for v in a[1:] if v != "X"
    )

grounded = []
for number, head, body in rules:
    has_variable = any("X" in a[1:] for a in (head,) + body)
    for value in sorted(constants) if has_variable else [None]:
        def substitute(a):
            return tuple(value if v == "X" else v for v in a)
        grounded.append((
            number, substitute(head), tuple(substitute(a) for a in body)
        ))

def step(known):
    applicable = [
        r for r in grounded if all(a in known for a in r[2])
    ]
    support = {}
    for number, head, _ in applicable:
        support.setdefault(head, set()).add(number)

    result = set(facts)
    for number, head, _ in applicable:
        opponents = support.get(opposite(head), set())
        if not any((other, number) in preferred for other in opponents):
            result.add(head)
    return result

known = set(facts)
seen = set()
while True:
    signature = frozenset(known)
    if signature in seen:
        print("UNSUPPORTED: preference evaluation did not converge")
        print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
        break
    seen.add(signature)
    updated = step(known)
    if updated == known:
        positive = atom("enjoys/swallow/beaver") in known
        negative = atom("-enjoys/swallow/beaver") in known
        print("Positive statement proved:", positive)
        print("Explicit negation proved:", negative)

        if positive and negative:
            print("UNSUPPORTED: conflicting conclusions")
            print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
        else:
            expected = "proved" if positive else "disproved" if negative else "unknown"
            print("Computed answer:", expected)
            print("Submitted answer: unknown")
            if negative:
                print(
                    "Derivation: education -> not hiding cards -> not surrendering"
                    " -> snake photo -> swears to leopard; notebook fits ->"
                    " bear called flamingo -> dances with crab -> not united"
                    " with vampire; hence suspects pigeon -> swallow neglects"
                    " stork -> smiles at dinosaur -> does not enjoy beaver."
                )
            print("CHECK PASS" if expected == "unknown" else "CHECK FAIL")
        break
    known = updated
